visual_decision: Retain d7d as incremental integration; COLOR_0-only alternative9f rejected for negligible visible improvement. Final face/AAA approval pending.
scope: Actual Game first room lighting/materials, fixed idle. Head local yaw/pitch fixtures and close camera reframes. No normal gameplay/timing QA, target-GPU performance or AAA approval.
findings: Sclera, gray-green iris rim and central dark pupil/catchlight are separately visible in Web close views. This is not a single black void or flat painted overlay.
Eyes follow the actual sampled Head bone through local yaw+/-15 and pitch+/-10 representative combinations. No offset/overscale or obvious through-eyelid geometry was seen in these views.
Actual eye model world basis scales remain approximately1. Both quality0 and1 preserve eye materials and placement.

Large dark pupil regions and heavy upper/lower lid surround give a stylized/doll-like stare in both qualities. Improve iris/pupil readability via one audited COLOR_0-only actual asset alternative before adoption.
Normal gameplay, complete animation sequence, blink/gaze behavior, Windows and final AAA approval remain untested.
